title: feat(electron): 添加 AI 上下文复制功能
body:
## 变更内容
- 在 Electron demo 顶部工具栏新增 `AI` 按钮，用于一键复制当前笔记的 AI 上下文。
- 复制内容包含当前笔记路径、字数统计、选中文本、大纲、已链接提及、未链接提及和 Markdown 原文。
- 通过 Electron preload 暴露剪贴板写入能力，避免依赖不稳定的浏览器剪贴板 API。

## 为什么这样做
这个改动让 Nexus 的本地 Markdown 笔记库更适合与 AI 助手协作。用户可以快速把当前笔记及其周边上下文交给 ChatGPT、Claude 或其他 AI 工具，而不需要手动整理大纲和反向链接信息。

## 验证方式
- `corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/electron-demo/test/ai-context.test.ts apps/electron-demo/test`
- `corepack pnpm test`
- `corepack pnpm -r exec tsc --noEmit`
- `corepack pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-electron-demo build`

commits_at_first_review.message: feat(electron): add AI context copy action

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+# Change: Add AI context copy action
+
+## Why
+The Electron demo already models a local-first Markdown vault with outline and backlink context, but users still need to manually gather that context before asking an AI assistant for help. A one-click context bundle makes the demo better express Nexus as an AI-native writing surface without introducing an external AI dependency.
+
+## What Changes
+- Add an Electron demo toolbar action for copying the active note's AI-ready context.
+- Include the active note path, document stats, selected text, outline, backlinks, unlinked mentions, and Markdown source.
+- Keep the feature host-side only: no public core API changes and no network calls.
+
+## Impact
+- Affected specs: `electron-demo`
+- Affected code: `apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/app.ts`, `apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/ai-context.ts`, `apps/electron-demo/electron/preload.ts`, `apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/bridge.d.ts`

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+## ADDED Requirements
+### Requirement: AI Context Copy
+The Electron demo SHALL let users copy an AI-ready context bundle for the active Markdown note without calling an external AI service.
+
+#### Scenario: Copy active note context
+- **WHEN** the user activates the AI context toolbar action
+- **THEN** the clipboard receives a Markdown bundle containing the active note path, document stats, selected text when present, outline entries, linked mentions, unlinked mentions, and the current Markdown source
+
+#### Scenario: Use vault-relative source labels
+- **WHEN** the active note and mention sources are inside the current vault
+- **THEN** the copied context uses vault-relative paths instead of absolute file paths

@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+## 1. Implementation
+- [x] 1.1 Add AI context formatter for active note metadata
+- [x] 1.2 Add Electron demo toolbar copy action
+- [x] 1.3 Add unit coverage for context formatting
